label: Concurrent event ingestion — single MERGE per event across 50 threads. Neo4j driver session pool (idiomatic equivalent of per-thread psycopg2 connection). MERGE on id backed by a UNIQUE constraint on :EventQ8(id) (PK equivalent, == INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING). Label cleared before each run (TRUNCATE equivalent). EventQ8 label used to isolate Q8 data from benchmark events.
